title: Defined below, called above
prompt: Write a function `wave` that prints "waving", and put its definition below `run` in the file. Call it from run. Godot reads the whole script before running anything, so the order of definitions does not matter.
hints: Definitions can sit anywhere in the script; only the order of calls matters.
Leave a blank line after run, then `func wave():` and its print.

docs.name: print(value)
docs.what: Shows value in the output. Takes anything; returns nothing.
